//: Type-checks the front-end WITHOUT a build. The files under static/js
are served to the browser exactly as written; tsc only reads them.
`npm run check` (or python check_frontend.py) runs it. Types come
from JSDoc comments in the modules and from static/js/types.d.ts,
which declares the globals the CDN scripts and the desktop bridge
put on window. strict is off to start with: the point is to catch
an undeclared name or a wrong call, not to annotate 5000 lines at
once - tighten it as the modules are split out.
